name: TimeRangePicker
title: Components/Forms/TimeRangePicker
description: Move between relative monitoring windows and precise UTC ranges.
purpose: Move between relative monitoring windows and precise UTC ranges.
usage: Relative values use a preset; absolute values use ISO from/to strings. Both forms share the public TimeRange type.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible standalone label. A surrounding Field supplies its own label.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that describes the object.

props.name: aria-invalid
props.description: Indicates the entered value does not conform to the format expected by the application.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that labels the current element.
